latestPosts.caption:
Your body sets the pace, not the timer ⏲️ 

Open for community sauna and cold plunge sessions daily. No protocol. Just heat, cold, and tuning into what your body’s telling you.

September snapshots ⛅️🚴🍂🌞♨️

Run clubs, our first ever Red Rock Riders bike ride, a clothing swap, new partners like @bodyrokdenver and @myfitfoods.highlands, and a whole lot of memories made with this community.

So much fun with all of you this month. More to come 😏

We love the sauna in every season but there’s something special about the fall 🔥🍂

The fire pit is back on, the air is crisp, and stepping into the heat when it’s cool outside just hits differently.

We’ve got a full month of sessions and events to match the energy. Come feel it for yourself.

All booking links in bio!

Come as you are. Everyone else did :)

(Unless you’re Syd and Mo, then you might want to match. No notes!)

Our first member social in March 2025 started with less than 10 people. And now look at this 🥹

Last night was another reminder of how much these little gatherings have grown - and how much they’ve become a part of Red Rock Sauna.

We’re so proud and grateful to still see so many of the faces who were there in the beginning, alongside all the new ones who have found their way to us since.

We built the sauna. You helped build everything around it.

After our last few socials, we’re feeling pretty in awe of what these socials have become ❤️

- Red Rock Sauna

Bike ride into Golden this Saturday 9/26 🚴🍂

Red Rock Riders - our very first casual group bike ride. Rolling out from Hogshead Brewery in Denver along Clear Creek trail into Golden and back. 

Social pace, all riders welcome, no pressure.

Stick around after for an optional sauna and cold plunge to top it off 🔥

Just bring your bike, water, and good vibes.

Link in bio to let us know you’re coming!

Heat. Cold. Coffee.

That’s a session at Red Rock Sauna. Every time you book, you get 20% off @slohicoffee next door - because we think a morning cold plunge and a great latte go perfectly together.

We’re open at 7 am Fridays through Mondays for your morning wake up call. 

Round it out at @hogshead54 for BOGO beverages to keep the good times rolling. 

This is the block. Come be part of it 🧊☕

Your closet called. It’s ready to let some things go 🔄

Join us on the @hogshead54 patio for a casual clothing swap. Bring gently used pieces you’re done with, trade them for something new-to-you, and hang with the community while you’re at it.

Open to everyone. Anything left at the end of the night gets donated!

Want to make a full evening of it? Book a sauna and cold plunge session separately through the link in bio ♨️💦

Tuesday, September 22 from 6-8 pm

RSVP for the swap at the link in bio!
Whatever your week looks like, there’s a seat for you here 🤝

The neighborhood spot you didn’t know you needed ❤️‍🔥

Fall is here and it’s our favorite time of year. We’re leaning into all of it - deeper heat, more great connections, new beer releases from @hogshead54, food offerings five nights a week, and events worth clearing your calendar for.

This week: 🧘 Tonight (Mon 9/21) — Red Rock Unplugged, 7pm ♻️ Tues 9/22 — Clothing Swap, 6-8pm 🍻 Thurs 9/24 — Member Sauna Social with sauna, plunge, beverages + @myfitfoods.highlands, 5-7pm 🚴 Sat 9/26 — Red Rock Riders bike to Golden, 7am

Plus our community sauna and cold plunge sessions daily. Come as you are! Link in bio to sign up.

See you there :) 

- Red Rock Sauna

latestPosts.caption:
濕氣、攰攰地，借住 “落雨絲濕” 講下人人都不以為意 —“出汗。 透過「出身汗」無可否認首選且的確一身輕、鬆馳感。 
但以為簡單既出身汗，對「一類人」係一種奢侈。 
🗣️：我知！
🤫：講之前，先講講咩方法 
🗣️：運動囉！仲洗講既

通過運動無錯…係首選方法、門檻低咁達到目的~「出汗、排濕氣」； 但相比起長期飽受難出汗，係截然兩班人，運動並唔適用。 佢哋錢花過、心機用過想辦法出身汗，絕對知運動好處但，唔適用就係唔適用。
🗣️ 點解運動唔啱，同咩有關？ 
🤫 同代謝有關。 
要知道代謝對身體溫度調節，心率等係主要功能。 
🗣️：不論形式，運動正正幫到代謝，唔係咩？！
 🤫：正確，但對方跟足情況依舊呢？ 
🗣️：…運動再push d, 唔夠上埋caffeine 心跳快實得幫到代謝呱？ 

如果依類情況客人或客人自己本身要份外小心。 因為佢地接受運動、treatment會可能較易暈倒、心臟負荷特發情況出現。 就算教練做足Par-Q 問卷都唔易察覺；
可歸類假想為 低甲亢(hypothyroidism)/紅血球偏低。須細項驗血，一般驗身並未考慮。

綜納如有上述單一 新陳代謝低之外，更要有以下： 
1.手腳冰冷； 
2.怕凍異於常人； 
3.BMI 指數偏高； 
4.體力、說話特別廢力氣。
依類人群身邊什為不少，正正係冷氣房 sedentary既打工仔，常自以為同少運動有關。 
🗣️：咁天氣潮濕想運動幫手唔得……桑拿得喇呱？！ 
🤫：桑拿一般60°c 已經對皮膚超負荷（43°c max), 上面提到代謝調節體溫失衡底下，密閉高溫環境會隨時誘發潛在心藏病發。
🤫：其實明白左原理，倘原造成「易凍、低代謝」原因係甲亢內分泌失衡所引起連串物理反應 e.g. 心率慢，可以從操控其心率快/慢既關鍵 — 自律神經 autonomic nervous system 入手。 

相比傳統桑拿，能符合以上，且具監察調節的紅外線/遠紅外線桑拿就十分適合。 
「手腳冰冷、易攰難出汗」TAKEWAY: 
📝運動依然適合但維持低带氧強度 e.g. 接近zone2; 
📝進行阻力訓練;
📝每星期餐飲滲入含海鮮、海带；
額外: supplement e.g. Q10, nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide(或者叫NAD）

以上情況請自行搵醫生或營養師，運動方面必須請私人教練。 

「關於閱讀內分泌所致的運動、生活日常可到網頁專欄，連結點開留言 ↓↓」
